summary: Constrain controller pods with node_selector and postgres_selector (nodes matching all labels) and tolerations and postgres_tolerations (nodes with matching taints); other spec fields include postgres_image (postgres), postgres_image_version (13), topology_spread_constraints and annotations. maxSkew 100 spreads pods maximally, one per matching node.
questions: How do I run automation controller pods on specific nodes?
What is postgres_selector in the AutomationController spec?
How do I use tolerations with the AAP operator?
What does maxSkew 100 do in topology_spread_constraints?
